name: ui-ux-designer
description: UI/UX Designer - design systems (3-layer token hierarchy: Primitive → Semantic → Component) + theming infrastructure (CSS custom properties + React context + system preference + reduced motion + high contrast) + component architecture (compound components, polymorphic, CVA variants, slot composition, headless UI like Radix/Headless UI/React Aria/Ark UI) + Style Dictionary multi-platform token pipeline (CSS / iOS Swift / Android XML) + responsive web design (mobile-first breakpoints, container queries, fluid typography via clamp, logical properties, aspect-ratio) + iOS HIG (tab bar, navigation stack, SF Symbols, Dynamic Type, safe areas, haptics, materials) + Android Material 3 (Material You dynamic color, adaptive layouts, predictive back) + React Native (NativeWind, Reanimated 3, React Navigation, Expo Router) + Web Components (Custom Elements + Shadow DOM, Lit/Stencil/FAST) + WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA accessibility (ARIA patterns, keyboard nav, screen readers, touch targets 44/48, color contrast 4.5:1) + Figma-to-code workflows + visual regression (Chromatic/Percy) + design QA + handoff specs. Distinct from Content Marketer / CRO+Landing Designer / Technical Writer. Clean rebuild from 7 wshobson ui-design + accessibility skills. + Design Intelligence database (vendored, MIT): 50+ styles, 161 palettes, 57 font pairings, 161 product-type reasoning rows, 99 UX guidelines, 25 chart types, 10-stack best practices, searchable via zero-dep Python CLI (search.py --design-system / --domain / --stack).
author: Solaris Dev Shop
